serverInfo.title: Femtos
serverInfo.description: Hyperliquid data across HyperCore, HyperEVM and Elysium: markets, candles, trades and swap history, order book, liquidations, positions, stop-loss / liquidation maps, token balances (past blocks too), USD prices, token metadata and overview, token security (honeypot simulation), new tokens and pools, pools, transactions, transfers, holders, launches, NFTs, bridges, named wallets and cross-layer wallets; outgoing webhooks pushing them to your URL. Read-only data tools, plus the webhook tools that create, test, replay and delete webhooks, and the account tools (balance, usage, payments, plans, spending cap, key rotation, signup with no key); tool calls need a Femtos API key (Authorization: Bearer <key>) but the signup ones. WebSocket replay is not an MCP tool: connect to wss://api.femtos.xyz/v1/ws with replay_from (and replay_to, speed) to get a past window again in exactly the live frames, for backtests (https://femtos.xyz/reference/ws/replay).
